title: Engines & Empires
description: A modpack centered around Create. Explore, conquer, and build as you seek to create your new empire!
body:
# Multiplayer-focused | Community Server Coming Soon!

**👉 Join our Discord for updates and to claim your place in the new world!**

## 🌍 Expand Your Empire

Build powerful cannons, missiles, and artillery to crush enemy fortresses and seize new lands. Conquer rival empires and grow your dominion through strength and industry.

## 🛡️ Defend What’s Yours

Your empire won’t go unchallenged. Construct radar arrays, missile defense systems, and armor plating to protect your cities and factories. Anticipate enemy strikes and ensure your empire stands tall against all threats.

## 🚂 Connect Your Lands

An empire thrives on logistics. Build expansive train networks and hypertube systems to move people, goods, and resources across your territories.

## 🏭 Industrialize with Create

At the core of the pack lies the Create mod. Use gears, shafts, belts, and flywheels to design intricate factories, workshops, and supply chains.

Expanded recipes for more depth and progression

Better crafting ratios for easier production

Early game ore doubling with sandpaper


## ☢️ Split the Atom

For those who dare to go further: unlock nuclear technology.

Harvest fissile materials

Construct a massive multiblock reactor

Generate more power than your empire could ever consume

Nuclear power is the final step in your industrial revolution, use it wisely.
